$comment: The Annex A.1 implementor-defined items WHOSE VALUES THE STANDARD ENUMERATES (DESIGN-conformance-suite.md §3.3).
A test whose expected output depends on one of them names it in `implementor-defined` and carries one expected
output per value, <id>.<item>=<value>.out; each compiler's profile states its value. An item whose values the
standard does not enumerate cannot be an expectation, so its tests are WiseOwl-only (wiseowl/cases/).
Each entry names its inventory row (DOC-A.1-<item>) and quotes the rule that enumerates the values; the generator
(harness/generate.py) refuses an entry without them, and a test naming an item not listed here.

148.element: RECORD clause (whether fixed or variable records produced for fixed-or-variable-length format)
148.citation: §13.18.43.4 GR 17: "It is implementor defined whether format 3 of the RECORD clause produces fixed-length records or variable-length records."

204.element: TURN directive (whether location information is available when the LOCATION phrase is not specified)
204.citation: §7.3.25.4 GR 7: "If the LOCATION phrase is not specified, the implementor shall specify whether this information is made available or not."
